prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a hyper-realistic 4K candid nightlife photograph of a generic clearly adult woman with long, messy copper-red hair and heavy blush, leaning toward the camera and pointing a finger gun at the viewer. She has an energetic playful face, open-mouth laugh, slight wink and glossy lips. She wears a black sleeveless deep-V fashion top with a large rectangular buckle on the chest and a leopard-print shoulder bag. The background is a crowded dark club with a blonde adult woman turned away, a bearded adult man in a white shirt and a tattooed adult man in the deeper background. The foreground includes a table with white drinks and a black energy-drink can with unreadable labeling. Use hard direct flash, high contrast, detailed natural skin texture, raw party atmosphere, slight film grain and 4K HD quality. Preserve the source gesture, outfit, crowd and flash aesthetic without reproducing Sadie Sink or any public-figure likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, distorted hands, readable brand logo, duplicate people
